text:
emily_fin: Quick alert — Verdant Labs got stacked discounts on invoice VD-2211: reseller-credit + seasonal promo applied together, resulting in a negative line and automated refund of $1,150 to card. Customer flagged it. Need to revert refund and issue corrected credit memo.

jason_ops: Can you paste the invoice lines?

emily_fin: Snippet (redacted):

```
Invoice VD-2211
2024-06-15
Line 3: reseller-discount -$800
Line 4: SEASONAL-JUN promo -$500
Line 5: subtotal (negative) -$300
Auto-refund (card) $1,150
```

priya_sales: Verdant is on a reseller plan; reseller discount should have masked promo eligibility. Looks like promo targeting missed the reseller flag. Customer worried about chargeback.

credits-bot: Heuristic: promo-stack-detection (confidence 78%). Suggested actions: 1) create corrective credit memo CM-VD-202406-CORR for $1,150 and 2) attempt to reverse auto-refund via payment-rail reversal.

emily_fin: Approve creating CM-VD-202406-CORR and initiate payment reversal. Also propose marking promo SEASONAL-JUN as exclusive to end-user purchases (exclude reseller accounts).

jason_ops: Will open bug INF-2024-732 to add reseller-exclusion to promo pipeline; adding idempotency guard for discount merge.

priya_sales: I'll draft the customer note: "We issued an erroneous refund due to stacked discounts; we've corrected your invoice and reversed the refund where possible. If you already received funds, we'll discuss offset options or make it a one-time courtesy. Apologies." Will post after finance update.

emily_fin: Posted credit memo CM-VD-202406-CORR (status: posted). Payment reversal requested (pay-ref-4482). If reversal fails, we'll record a receivable and coordinate with sales.

credits-bot: Actions logged: credit_posted, reversal_requested. Ticket FIN-2024-912 opened for reconciliation.

priya_sales: Sent customer note and flagged for AM follow-up if bank reversal doesn't clear.

emily_fin: Closing loop, will reopen FIN-2024-912 if reversal doesn't succeed within 7 days.
